hook_anchors.excerpt: Two words, and that healer's crown rolls right back into the gutter
hook_anchors.why: Catherine immediately establishes a cold, vindictive threat right at the start.

hook_anchors.excerpt: Ten days is not a wall, Alexander. It's a door.
hook_anchors.why: A chilling and menacing proclamation directed at her rival.

hook_anchors.excerpt: Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today.
hook_anchors.why: Leans directly into her recent public disgrace and weaponizes it.

hook_anchors.excerpt: I'm not leaving the county, Agnes. I'm going back into that house.
hook_anchors.why: A dangerous declaration of intent to re-enter the lion's den.

cliffhanger_anchors.open_question: How will Catherine close the door on Alexander from the other side?
cliffhanger_anchors.excerpt: And doors can be closed from the other side.
cliffhanger_anchors.why: Leaves her ominous scheme entirely open-ended.

cliffhanger_anchors.open_question: Will Agnes successfully smuggle the priest into the house without being caught?
cliffhanger_anchors.excerpt: And make sure no one sees him arrive.
cliffhanger_anchors.why: Sets up a high-stakes clandestine meeting that could ruin them if discovered.
